newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ericsson sees China as biggest market.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson sees China as biggest market.

text.p: China is set to become Swedish telecoms group Ericsson's largest market, perhaps by the end of this year, Managing Director Lars Ramqvist told a news conference during the Cebit technology fair.
"During 1996 China was our second-biggest market and it could definitely be the biggest, already this year," he said.
Ramqvist said that Ericsson's strategy in China remained to make the best use of local knowledge and its own know-how.
"We are building up in China with a Chinese organisation and Ericsson's technology," he said.
The group's biggest market at the moment is the United States, which generated 12 percent of sales in 1996 while China accounted for 10 percent.
